### Interface

- Geist is the new interface font, with one body size across chat, sidebar, file tree, tabs and dashboard.
- Reset buttons sit next to the Aa size controls, including on file previews.
- Click a chat bubble to see when it was sent.
- Agent status borders are now off by default.
- Hide and unhide are now called archive and unarchive.

### Dashboard and sidebar

- Dashboard cards show the agent icon, the current tool activity and a PR chip, sorted by last activity.
- Sidebar rows show how long ago each agent was last active.

![Dashboard cards with live tool activity and a PR chip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fastestdevalive/vibe-station/v0.0.3-beta/docs/screenshots/release/v0.0.3-beta/02-dashboard.png)

- Select several worktrees to archive or delete them in one pass, with progress and retry.
- Dragging a worktree now drops it where you released it.
- The project row shows its menu only on hover.
- Exited plain terminals are cleaned up, and an open terminal dock always has one terminal.

![Selecting worktrees to archive in the sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fastestdevalive/vibe-station/v0.0.3-beta/docs/screenshots/release/v0.0.3-beta/01-bulk-archive.png)

### Agents and chat

- A session whose mode was deleted can switch to Rich Chat by choosing a replacement mode.
- Edit diffs in Rich Chat show only the changed hunks, with line numbers.
- Diffs over the size cap show a clear message instead of a broken hunk.
- Long chats reopen faster, because replay is limited by size.
- Plain terminals no longer flip between idle and waiting.
- Mode context can now be empty.

### Workspace and setup

- The file tree shows gitignored folders dimmed and always shows `*.png` files.
- Settings has one tab per harness, with its modes listed below.
- Doctor shows the reason and a copyable fix for each missing tool.
- Tailscale installed outside your PATH is now detected on macOS.
- Browser terminals no longer stay blank, thanks to the Vite 8 upgrade.
- Updated rustls-webpki to 0.103.16.
